blocks.text: MADRID, Spain—Spain’s Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez acknowledged making “mistakes” as he faced off with his main conservative rival in a key debate on Thursday before an election next week. Observers say the polls could leave the far right on the cusp of power. The pair in the debate clashed over the economy, housing, immigration and corruption, repeatedly interrupting each other during the two-hour showdown. “My government has not been perfect. I have made mistakes. But I am also fully aware that we have always governed in the right direction,” Sanchez said at the outset. Pointing to economic growth and employment figures, […]...
